dialogues.en: "A dream......"
dialogues.text: "A dream......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや……なんでもない」
dialogues.en: "No...... Nothing."
dialogues.text: "No...... Nothing."

dialogues.jp: こんなにも幸せな夢だ。
dialogues.en: What a happy dream.
dialogues.text: What a happy dream.

dialogues.jp: 少しくらい寝坊しても構わないだろう。
dialogues.en: I shouldn't wake up too quickly.
dialogues.text: I shouldn't wake up too quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……終わって、また始まる」
dialogues.en: "You have the end, and the beginning."
dialogues.text: "You have the end, and the beginning."

dialogues.jp: 音夢が微笑む。
dialogues.en: Nemu smiles at me.
dialogues.text: Nemu smiles at me.

dialogues.jp:
終わるけど、また始まる――それが音夢の口癖
だった。
dialogues.en:
Everything ends but also begins again -- she says that all
the time.
dialogues.text:
Everything ends but also begins again -- she says that all
the time.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「でも、終わりがない夢だってあるんだよ、お
　兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "But there's a never-ending dream too, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "But there's a never-ending dream too, oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いくら繰り返そうとも――」
dialogues.en: "You can repeat it over and over ----"
dialogues.text: "You can repeat it over and over ----"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ダ・カーポがついていようとも――」
dialogues.en: "Even if you have da capo ----"
dialogues.text: "Even if you have da capo ----"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「オルゴールのネジが止まるように、やがて、
　生ある限り夢は訪れる」
dialogues.en: "As long as you live, you keep dreaming......"
dialogues.text: "As long as you live, you keep dreaming......"

dialogues.jp: まぶたが重い。
dialogues.en: My eyelids felt so heavy.
dialogues.text: My eyelids felt so heavy.

dialogues.jp: なぜか、家の中なのに桜の匂いがする。
dialogues.en: I smell the scent of cherry blossom in the house.
dialogues.text: I smell the scent of cherry blossom in the house.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「深々と桜は降りしきる」
dialogues.en: "The cherry blossom falls like snow."
dialogues.text: "The cherry blossom falls like snow."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「穏やかに――天使の羽のように柔らかく、お
　兄ちゃんを包み込む」
dialogues.en:
"Gently...... like a feather of an angel. It'll cover you,
oniichan."
dialogues.text:
"Gently...... like a feather of an angel. It'll cover you,
oniichan."

dialogues.jp:
母親が子供に子守唄を聞かせるような、なめら
かでゆったりとした｛うた／詩｝。
dialogues.en: The poem sounded like a lullaby sang by a mother to a child.
dialogues.text: The poem sounded like a lullaby sang by a mother to a child.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「次に目が覚めるときには、全てが終わってい
　るから……」
dialogues.en:
"Everything will be finished when you wake up next
time......"
dialogues.text:
"Everything will be finished when you wake up next
time......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「深々とおやすみなさい」
dialogues.en: "Go into a deep sleep."
dialogues.text: "Go into a deep sleep."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Oniichan......"
dialogues.text: "Oniichan......"

dialogues.jp: ◆子守唄◆
dialogues.en: ◆A lullaby◆
dialogues.text: ◆A lullaby◆

dialogues.jp: こんなに幸せな夢なら見つづけてもいいだろう。
dialogues.en: I could dream forever if I was this happy.
dialogues.text: I could dream forever if I was this happy.

dialogues.jp: 音夢の笑みに包まれながら、俺は眠りに落ちた。
dialogues.en: I fell asleep wrapped with her smile.
dialogues.text: I fell asleep wrapped with her smile.
